selection_rule: For each listed source FASTA, retain the first 2000 FASTA records in file order.
baseline_command: contigger merge --manifest samples.tsv --output-prefix baseline --identity 98 --min-overlap 1000 --kmer-size 21 --window-size 10 --min-shared-minimisers 5 --max-minimiser-frequency 20 --threads 4 --evidence none --index-dir indexes
tightened_command: contigger merge --manifest samples.tsv --output-prefix tightened --identity 99 --min-overlap 2000 --kmer-size 31 --window-size 15 --min-shared-minimisers 8 --max-minimiser-frequency 20 --threads 4 --evidence none --index-dir tight-indexes

decision_preservation.reason: The tightened settings reduce candidate work on this subset but fail the checked-in Pseudomonas decision-preservation gate around the identity_9799 regression and must not be adopted.
